scripts.install:all: pnpm install && pnpm --dir backend install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --dir frontend install --frozen-lockfile
scripts.build: pnpm --dir backend build && pnpm --dir frontend build
scripts.lint: pnpm --dir backend lint && pnpm --dir frontend lint
scripts.format: prettier --write . && pnpm --dir backend format && pnpm --dir frontend format
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && pnpm --dir backend format:check && pnpm --dir frontend format:check
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir backend typecheck && pnpm --dir frontend typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --dir backend test && pnpm --dir frontend test
scripts.quality: prettier --check . && pnpm --dir backend quality && pnpm --dir frontend quality
